node.statement: By def-extcb-datum, v:M_r->S_P is an extended delta-isomorphism. Hence its restriction v_D to D_r is linear, star-preserving, delta-multiplicative for the compressed product, and obeys the same two-sided norm bounds. The external lem-compcb-corner-algebra makes S_P an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra for universal small e (P is nonvanishing because v is onto the nonzero space S_P). The registered compressed-product estimate differs from the ambient product by O(e) on bounded elements. Thus v_D, viewed as a map into A, is a non-unital c_D*e-inclusion for a universal c_D independent of r, with v_D(Pi_a)=R_a and v_D(I)=v(I_r).
